articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as stocks rally following Anthropic IPO filing
articles.snippet: Alongside Anthropic raising as much as $100 billion, Meta on Monday announced a $95 billion share sale to fund its own AI ambitions.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips under $80,000 as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting
articles.snippet: Ether and XRP led losses among the majors as the AI trade took another hit in Asia, where Goldman Sachs cut its Kospi target by 25%.

articles.title: Elon Musk issues a warning for 'AI neoclouds' as SpaceX borrows $40 billion for chips
articles.snippet: SpaceX has raised $40 billion in debt to buy GPUs, while Musk predicts a major shakeout among smaller AI cloud providers.

articles.title: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions
articles.snippet: The U.K. claims to aspire to become a global cryptocurrency hub, an ambition that would appear to be at odds with the attitude to crypto purchases of its major banks.

articles.title: Crypto under weekend pressure, bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
articles.snippet: Bitcoin has sunk to its weakest level in more than one month.
